scope: Root directly inspected actual first-pass head, right side and three-quarter authoring renders against July head and candidate03 full body. This is agent visual judgment, not owner acceptance.

findings.finding: Cheek and brow members read as thick tubing and partially obscure optic; large crown-side void remains.
findings.action: Replace with shallow shaped forged ribbons, clear optic aperture, contiguous crown/orbital backing.

findings.finding: Visible triangular sliver/spike artifacts in lateral fields; repeated courses remain dominant.
findings.action: Repair self-crossing outlines and projection winding before further styling; overlap curved fields.

findings.finding: Large channels and long smooth backing surfaces separate plate courses.
findings.action: Increase root overlap and grade short coverts into swept distal plates.

findings.finding: Stacked solid bearing disks conceal proposed stepped races; ankle segments read as one tube and claws as needles.
findings.action: Use true annular relief, visible sheath overlap and substantial tapered claw sections.

preservation: This render/model set is rejected as a final candidate and will remain under iterations/182c21c0c5f8 on the next build.
